what.title: What is Parkinson's disease? Parkinsonism vs Parkinson's
what.description: Parkinsonism is slowness with a rest tremor or stiffness; Parkinson's disease is its commonest cause. Who it affects, how it rises with age, and the numbers.

circuit.title: The dopamine pathway in Parkinson's: substantia nigra to striatum
circuit.description: How dopamine from the substantia nigra keeps the brain's go and brake loops in balance, and what happens as the neurons are lost. Animated, step by step.

synuclein.title: Alpha-synuclein and Lewy bodies in Parkinson's, animated
synuclein.description: A small synaptic protein misfolds, clumps into Lewy bodies and may spread from cell to cell. The steps, the GBA1 and SNCA links, and what is still debated.

braak.title: Braak stages of Parkinson's disease: how it spreads
braak.description: Braak's six stages, from the brainstem and smell pathway to the cortex, the body-first and brain-first idea, and the cases that do not fit.

genes.title: Parkinson's genes: LRRK2, GBA1, SNCA and parkin explained
genes.description: Which genes raise the chance of Parkinson's, how often carriers develop it by age, why it is commoner in Ashkenazi and Berber families, and what a test means.

prodrome.title: Early signs before Parkinson's: dream enactment, smell, constipation
prodrome.description: The prodromal years: loss of smell, constipation and REM sleep behaviour disorder can come years before the tremor. The research criteria, as a calculator.

stages.title: Stages of Parkinson's disease: Hoehn and Yahr, symptoms, course
stages.description: The Hoehn and Yahr stages from one side to wheelchair, how long each lasts, motor subtypes, and what long-term studies show about the course.

dx.title: How Parkinson's is diagnosed: the MDS criteria calculator
dx.description: Run the 2015 MDS clinical diagnostic criteria yourself: parkinsonism, exclusions, red flags and supportive features. Plus DaT scans and synuclein tests.

ddx.title: Parkinson's or something else? Tremor, MSA, PSP and more
ddx.description: Essential tremor, drug-induced and vascular parkinsonism, MSA, PSP, CBD and Lewy body dementia, told apart by tremor, speed, falls and levodopa response.

levodopa.title: How levodopa and carbidopa work, from pill to brain
levodopa.description: Follow a levodopa dose from the stomach to the striatum: why carbidopa matters, how protein meals interfere, and what MAO-B and COMT inhibitors add.

wearing.title: Levodopa wearing-off and dyskinesia over the years, animated
wearing.description: A day of levodopa doses in early and advanced Parkinson's: why doses wear off, when dyskinesia appears, and how infusions and add-ons smooth the curve.

drugs.title: Parkinson's medications: agonists, MAO-B and COMT inhibitors
drugs.description: Dopamine agonists, MAO-B and COMT inhibitors, amantadine and newer drugs: how each works, what trials show, and side effects such as impulse control.

dbs.title: Deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's: how it works, who it helps
dbs.description: Electrodes in the subthalamic nucleus or globus pallidus, the stimulation field, adaptive DBS, who is a candidate and what the trials found. Animated.

nonmotor.title: Non-motor symptoms of Parkinson's: mood, hallucinations, sleep
nonmotor.description: Depression, hallucinations, dementia, sleep, low blood pressure on standing and more: how common they are and what guidelines say helps.

risk.title: Parkinson's risk factors: pesticides, head injury, coffee, exercise
risk.description: What raises and what is linked to lower Parkinson's risk, with the size of each effect, the caveats about cause, and what prevention trials found.

living.title: Living with Parkinson's: exercise, falls, speech and caregiving
living.description: Exercise and therapy, freezing and falls, speech and swallowing, work, driving, hospital stays, caregiving and palliative care, as guidelines describe.

nursing.title: Parkinson's nursing care: medicines on time and drugs to avoid
nursing.description: For nurses: time-critical medicines, nil by mouth, drugs to avoid, assessment scales such as the MDS-UPDRS, falls and swallowing, and documentation.

cure.title: Parkinson's research: synuclein antibodies, GLP-1, cell therapy
cure.description: The routes being tried to slow or repair Parkinson's, from synuclein antibodies and GLP-1 drugs to LRRK2, GBA1, cell and gene therapy, with evidence labels.

history.title: History of Parkinson's disease: from James Parkinson to DBS
history.description: From James Parkinson's 1817 essay through Charcot, Lewy, the discovery of dopamine and levodopa, to deep brain stimulation and the synuclein test.

review.title: Parkinson's disease flashcards and mnemonics
review.description: Flashcards and mnemonics on Parkinson's disease by topic: the disease, diagnosis, treatment, living and caring, and history. Flip, filter or shuffle.

quiz.title: Parkinson's disease quiz, with explanations
quiz.description: Test yourself on Parkinson's: the dopamine pathway, diagnosis, levodopa, DBS and care. Every answer has an explanation. Take a mixed quiz or one part.

glossary.title: Parkinson's disease glossary: every term explained
glossary.description: Plain definitions of the terms in Parkinson's care and research, from alpha-synuclein to wearing-off. Searchable, each linked to its module.

sources.title: Sources and references | Parkinson's Companion
sources.description: Every reference behind Parkinson's Companion: journal articles, guidelines, drug labels and trial registrations, searchable and filtered by topic.
